items.title: Rick Montalbano interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, August 12, 2011
items.q: And then I started playing with a saxophone player by the name of Tony Madonia.

ctx.x: Where are you going this afternoon? Do you remember that? © Hamilton College Jazz Archive -17-

No I don’t even know where I am right now. But yeah, so I saw Jill. She was with her then-boyfriend and I knew him. We were playing in this tent at Montgomery Wards in Rome in the parking lot at some kind of grand opening or something. And she came in with him and immediately it was like oh my Lord, you know, who is that? How can I get next to her? You know. And then I didn’t see her for another three years. But I thought about her for three years. And then I started playing with a saxophone player by the name of…
